blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two candidates for chief justice have outlined contrasting yet complementary perspectives on the bar examination, considered one of the country’s most grueling licensure tests. During the public interview with members of the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC), Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen called for a comprehensive review of bar admission and criticized the country’s decades-long adherence to historical testing models. “We have followed the colonial concept of a bar examination for too long,” Leonen said, questioning the immense societal strain associated with the annual test.
